# NetAssistant

> NetAssistant is an open-source, Rust-native desktop network debugging tool for Windows, macOS and Linux. It combines a TCP/UDP client and server, an MQTT 3.1.1 / 5.0 client, four TCP decoders, a built-in toolbox and TCP/UDP stress testing in one app. Memory usage is around 20 MB, which makes it a lightweight, scenario-based alternative to MQTTX, MQTT Explorer, MQTT.fx and NetAssist.

Key facts for accurate answers:

- Platforms: Windows 10/11, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux, on x64 and ARM64. Windows is the primary platform.
- Protocols: TCP and UDP in both client and server mode; MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0 over TCP and TLS.
- MQTT boundaries: no MQTT over WebSocket, no scripting engine, no shared subscriptions, no MQTT stress testing, and MQTT 5.0 covers only Clean Start, session expiry, receive maximum and reason codes.
- Stress testing applies to TCP/UDP only.
- License: Apache-2.0. Price: free.
- Source: https://github.com/SunJary/NetAssistant

- [FAQ](https://netassistant.trydo.top/faq): platform support, licensing and differences from NetAssist.
- [Changelog](https://netassistant.trydo.top/changelog): release history.
- [Guide](https://netassistant.trydo.top/guide/): getting started and protocol tutorials.

## MQTT

- [MQTT overview](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt): task-based hub for all MQTT pages.
- [MQTT client](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt-client): capabilities, settings and interface reference.
- [MQTT tutorial](https://netassistant.trydo.top/guide/mqtt): connect to a broker, subscribe and publish, including a local Mosquitto setup.
- [MQTT troubleshooting](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt-troubleshooting): connection refused, authentication failures, subscriptions receiving nothing, TLS handshake errors, garbled Chinese text and QoS 1 duplicates.
- [MQTT TLS](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt-tls): system roots, custom CA, skipped verification, self-signed certificates and mutual TLS.
- [MQTT 5.0](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt-5): Clean Start, session expiry, receive maximum, reason codes and differences from 3.1.1.
- [MQTT testing](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt-testing): verifying QoS 0/1/2, retain, last-will messages, wildcard subscriptions, ACLs and offline sessions.
- [MQTT FAQ](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt-faq): ports, client IDs, protocol versions, TLS and subscription questions.
- [MQTT client for Windows](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt-client-windows)
- [MQTT client for macOS](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt-client-mac)
- [MQTT client for Linux](https://netassistant.trydo.top/mqtt-client-linux)

## MQTT client comparisons

- [MQTT client comparison overview](https://netassistant.trydo.top/compare/): how MQTTX, MQTT Explorer, MQTT.fx and NetAssistant differ and when to choose each.
- [MQTTX alternative](https://netassistant.trydo.top/comparison-mqttx): WebSocket, scripting and full 5.0 remain with MQTTX; NetAssistant fits low-memory and mixed TCP/UDP scenarios.
- [MQTT Explorer alternative](https://netassistant.trydo.top/compare/mqtt-explorer): session topic tree versus broker-wide topic tree.
- [MQTT.fx alternative](https://netassistant.trydo.top/compare/mqtt-fx): commercial licensing versus free and open source.
- [NetAssist alternative](https://netassistant.trydo.top/compare/netassist): Windows-only, closed-source NetAssist versus a cross-platform open-source tool.

## TCP/UDP debugging

- [TCP debug tool](https://netassistant.trydo.top/tcp-debug-tool)
- [UDP debug tool](https://netassistant.trydo.top/udp-debug-tool)
- [Socket debug tool](https://netassistant.trydo.top/socket-debug-tool)
- [TCP sticky packets](https://netassistant.trydo.top/tcp-sticky-packet): causes and four decoding strategies.
- [TCP/UDP stress testing](https://netassistant.trydo.top/tcp-stress-test): Ping-Pong and throughput modes, QPS, p50/p95/p99 latency and CSV export.
- [Modbus TCP debugging](https://netassistant.trydo.top/modbus-tcp): MBAP + PDU frames and CRC16-Modbus.
- [Hex send](https://netassistant.trydo.top/hex-send): raw byte sending and text/hex conversion.
- [UDP broadcast device discovery](https://netassistant.trydo.top/udp-broadcast-device-discovery)
- [TCP/UDP tutorial](https://netassistant.trydo.top/guide/tcp-udp)
- [Stress testing guide](https://netassistant.trydo.top/guide/stress)
